notes.title: Indie Cup Celebration 2023!
notes.content:
Indie Cup Celebration 2023!

Celebrate Indie Cup 2023 with us and help Cassandra on her quest to uncover the mysteries of a dark world she is trapped in!

We have rolled out a small update that fixes a few bugs and balances the difficulty in some later stages of the game:

[list]
[*] Golems should no longer hit you through walls when standing too close to them
[*] TrueSight now recharges slightly faster
[*] Improved hints for several puzzles
[/list]

Enjoy!

notes.title: Release date announcement!
notes.content:
[h1]Release date[/h1]
Good news everyone! Now that the development of the game is finished we can confirm the release date. [b]It is set to 25th March[/b], which means that there is now less than five weeks before the game is out. We can't wait for all of you to play it!

[h1]Development update[/h1]
Most of our time is now spent fixing bugs that came up during testing, polishing translations and making sure the game runs perfectly smooth. Here is a list of most notable changes:

[list]
[*] Added Polish translations (thanks [b]JaaDlugi[/b]!)
[*] Increased the internal cooldown of "Cheat Death" perk to 90 seconds but added a 10 second reduction everytime the player dies
[*] Increased the amount of cooldown reduction for both Inquisitor and Truth Seer perks
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented completing the sixth chapter on easy difficulty (thanks [b]FrozenShiver[/b])
[*] Improved skill tooltips to better reflect changes due to perks
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed players to skip certain parts of some levels with clever use of the Dash Skill
[*] Fixed a rare bug that allowed ghosts to kill the player even if they were dead
[*] Many more smaller fixes
[/list]

Thats all for today. We are still looking for more testers, particularly for proofreading French and Spanish translations. If you are interested let us know on our [url=https://discord.gg/BgHzbyWnd2]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Demo updated, full release is near!
notes.content:
[h1]Demo updated[/h1]

We have updated our demo. The new version brings many new features and improvements:

[list]
[*] Controller support
[*] New perk system
[*] Improved level layout
[*] Improved visuals and effects
[*] More settings, remappable controls
[/list]

We would love to hear your feedback! Head to our official [url=https://discord.gg/BgHzbyWnd2]Discord [/url]and let us know what you think!

[h1]Full release soon![/h1]

Good news! Its only 3 months until release and we are confident we will be able to meet the release date without problems. The game is nearly finished and we are just polishing and testing things, making sure the launch goes as smooth as possible.

Keep an eye out for closed beta announcement here on Steam or on our social media!

notes.title: Perk System Update
notes.content:
[h1]Reworked perk system[/h1]

Initially the perk system was just a small feature that added some quality of life improvements. For example you could choose to have a perk that made secrets more easy to find or reduced the time it took to respawn at a checkpoint after death.

But during testing I realized that the perks are boring. There was not much incentive to look for perk points as the benefits they introduced were quite small and had negligible impact on gameplay. So I decided to change this and make the perk system an important part of the game.

[h1]New perks[/h1]

I kept some of the old perks - for example the one that helps find secrets is quite nice if you don't want to look up guides on the internet but prefer to discover stuff on your own.

But many new ones were added with the goal of allowing the player to customize how he plays. Lets look at a couple of perks as an example.

[h2]Perk: Sprinter[/h2]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40459664/b7f03047d76bd074557ba9be648eacb7ce2ad8aa.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40459664/2e0bb50ff824f53853926747746ec80fb4f1fef9.png[/img][/url]
[i]You move 20% faster, but campsites no longer save your progress.[/i]

This is an example of a perk that gives a passive bonus (movement speed) but also introduces a drawback: you can no longer save your game during a chapter (progress is still saved upon completion of a chapter though!). This could be quite interesting for getting those speedrunning badges, but there is a risk - if you die too much, the speed bonus will be negated and your only option is to restart the run since you have no intermediate saves!

[h2]Perk: Dark thoughts[/h2]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40459664/8e92739ce9ad7d4ae4d3ee1912f5bbfb78a392ac.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40459664/440a6e675cfb7b15fde5178905cd6469e66e15d0.png[/img][/url]
[i]There is a 33% chance that weaker enemies will be killed by Mindblast.[/i]

This perk adds a new ability to one of the skills - the possibility to kill an enemy (and not just stun it)! It won't work always, but can be very useful against sections where there are many enemies - killing one of them could mean the difference between success and failure!

[h1]Tiered progression[/h1]

One problem with a flat perk system is that one can easily pick the most powerful perks at the start of the game. Also, some perks are useless since they interact with particular skills that are not yet unlocked at the beginning of the game. For this reason I have separated the perks into [b]three tiers[/b]. You will need to pick a perk or two from lower tiers before you can choose a perk from the highest tier. This way you will have to think a bit about what to choose!

Last thing that I had to solve was how to approach the problem of choosing a wrong perk. After all, you cannot know which perk is good for you if you don't try it first. And what to do if you find out a particular perk does not suit your playstyle? Don't worry. [b]You will be able to reset your perks[/b] at the start of each chapter. Once you progress a bit further, this option will no longer be available so make sure you have the right perks for the challenge ahead of you!

[h1]Feedback wanted[/h1]

What do you think about these changes? Do you have some ideas for perks? [url=https://discord.gg/BgHzbyWnd2]Hop into our discord[/url] and let us know!

notes.title: New Trailer!
notes.content:
[h2]New Trailer[/h2]

Finally after weeks of work we can show you our new trailer! We think it turned out amazing so go ahead and check it out:

[previewyoutube=uGb8O5U1eFo;full][/previewyoutube]

Enjoyed it? Like and share it with friends to help spread the word! :)

[h2]Development progress[/h2]

[olist]
[*] [b]Controller support[/b] - done and working as intended, we just need to test it a bit more before we update the demo
[*] [b]Difficulty balancing[/b] - we have tweaked several difficulty parameters - now traps should be much less annoying on easier difficulties while enemies should feel a bit more dangerous on harder settings
[*] [b]Content[/b] - regarding content, the game is about 85% complete right now and there is still plenty time before release so all is good
[/olist]

Right now we are focusing on finishing all the content for the game so we can start with testing and marketing efforts.

Thats all for now, see you next time!

notes.title: Devlog #6
notes.content:
Hey everyone, Peter here. I have decided to move the devlogs here instead of my [url=http://blog.p3tr.cz/]personal blog[/url]. This is in fact the sixth devlog i'm posting, but the first one here on Steam! :D

Since we already have a demo out and you guys can try the game I won't focus as much on stuff that's already done. Rather I want to mention a couple of things that people have asked about:

[h2]Controller support[/h2]

I have been toying with the idea to support controllers for some time and now that many requested it I have decided to implement it. If everything goes according to plan [b]you will be able to play the game using a controller[/b] and only need the mouse for menu and settings. Unfortunatelly supporting a controller fully would be quite hard to do at this point and I don't think I have the time to do that right now.

[h2]Game length[/h2]

Lots of you asked about how long the game will be. This is a tough question - from my testing it looks like to be somewhere between [b]4-6 hours so far for a first playthrough[/b]. If you ignore most of the secrets and achievements and play on EASY difficulty it could be even less than that, but also much more on HARD and going for a full completion. Keep in mind though that this is a very rough estimate.

[h2]Difficulty balancing[/h2]

Another tough one. A couple people complained about the difficulty, especially the train puzzle in the demo. I realized its a bit too punishing - some of you had to really "time your moves" perfectly. I pushed an update a couple of days ago that fixes this hopefully. This also alerted me to the fact that the game might be a bit too hard in the beginning so [b]I'm spending some time now to revise the first two chapters and balance the difficulty better.[/b]

[h2]Other[/h2]

Finally I want to talk about the trailer. Currently the one we have is a bit... bad. So I've been thinking of making a new one, but... its not really my cup of tea. Ok ok I suck at making trailers. Thats why I decided to let someone more skilled handle it. Hopefully I find the right person soon and [b]we will get a juicy trailer[/b]. Once I have more info to share about that I will let you all know.

Peter
